records.text: An unnamed Turning Point USA contact told Candace Owens that Elizabeth McCoy approved the recreated tent displayed at AmericaFest.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #12 (Ep OEAHy3SsIiI)

appearances.snippet: I messaged and I said, who did this? Who approved this? ... And the answer that I got, you're not going to believe this or you will believe this, that the person who approved this tent was the amazing Elizabeth McCoy.

verification.notes: No public record or authenticated communication establishes that Elizabeth approved the AmericaFest tent display.

conveyance.original_source: Private message to Turning Point USA contacts
